name: Private workspace CRUD and account separation
covers: manus sparas och kvarstår efter uppdatering
Live production status per owner using script revisions and private media review queue
Separate script and media review status to avoid false publish readiness
Live dashboard scan status with accurate enabled/disabled/unknown state
description: Owner A can create, edit and delete a script, then sign out; another session does not see owner A's draft or preview.
steps: Sign in as Actor A. Create and save a manual QA script, reload and verify it persists.
Edit the script and reload to confirm the new content is durable.
Open Videostudio, select the saved script, then log out.
Sign in as Actor B on the same device. Verify actor A's script and editor text are absent, and the dashboard shows only actor B's data.
Sign out Actor B; sign in Actor A, delete the QA script and reload to confirm it is gone.
After login, confirm Produktionsflöde reports separate manuscript count and private-video count and clearly labels each state.
Open a saved script via Produktionsflöde and verify it opens the same manuscript in Videostudio.
Open private video via Produktionsflöde and confirm it navigates to Videogranskning rather than automatically uploading.
Refresh the pipeline status after activating or disabling YouTube auto trends in Trendradar; never show unverified data as active.
expected: Scripts persist only for their owners, and no editor or preview data leaks across logins. The production dashboard distinguishes user-saved scripts, authenticated private MP4 review states, and separate owner-enabled YouTube scanning; no publication permissions are granted.

name: Database self-check, theme choice and compact navigation
covers: database creation, read, conditional update and deletion
light and dark mode after reload
description: A logged-in user can run a backend diagnostic without writing to personal project data.
steps: Sign in and open Systemkontroll.
Click Kör grundsystemtest and inspect detailed results.
Verify the diagnostic reports the actual server and database checks, and all passed when the database is operational.
Verify the queue API status appears and the page states that automatic scheduled work is paused.
Reload the page and confirm saved projects remain intact.
Go to System > Inställningar. Choose Ljust and confirm the page, sidebar, cards, forms and labels use a readable light palette.
Reload and sign out/in: Ljust must persist on the same account. A new account defaults to Mörkt. Switch back to Mörkt and verify dark appearance is unchanged.
Expand Upptäck, Skapa, Resultat and System from the simplified navigation; verify every original page is still accessible.
Open Översikt, expand Fler detaljer and Chefens statusunderlag and confirm their original actions remain available.
expected: Backend diagnostic returns evidenced checks without modifying saved projects. Any failing check is displayed explicitly. User-selected light/dark appearance persists per account; grouped navigation and collapsible overview retain all original functionality.

name: Controllable authenticated HTTP 503 and safe recovery
description: Simulate an actual HTTP 503 from a protected test route, exercise the same workspace loader and retry view used for a real failure.
steps: Sign in on an account with a saved test project. Go to Systemkontroll.
Click Simulera serverfel (503). Confirm the protected endpoint intentionally responds HTTP 503.
Confirm the normal workspace disappears, an error appears, and the screen shows Försök igen. It must never pretend that user projects were deleted.
Click Försök igen. Confirm the same account's saved projects and controls return, without changing their content.
Confirm no AI generation, automatic publishing or background job was started.
expected: The app fails visibly and closed on a genuine HTTP 503 response, then successfully reloads the original private workspace on retry.

name: Queue access, cancellation and safe guardrails
covers: Hourly owner-specific YouTube mostPopular collection without AI
Scheduler duplicate-claim guard and daily quota fallback
description: A user can inspect queue state and cannot accidentally trigger charged generation or publishing.
steps: Sign in and open Bakgrundsjobb; confirm visible quality-assurance pause disclosure.
Create one unpaid source-only task for a future time, confirm it persists on refresh.
Cancel the future job and reload; verify it remains cancelled.
Select AI pipeline with the explicit-cost checkbox unchecked, and verify it cannot be added.
Confirm the app has no automatic publishing or background render controls.
Sign in and open Trendradar. Verify auto collection defaults to off and no API call is made before opt-in.
With the YouTube key configured, explicitly activate hourly scanning and verify status is saved after reload; a second account must remain disabled.
At next scheduled hour, verify latest attempt/success from a real official popular-video observation; same UTC hour may only be claimed once, even with duplicated scheduler invocation.
Stop automatic scanning, reload and confirm status stays off; no new provider calls, video rendering, AI credits or public release.
For quota/403/429 conditions verify a visible cooldown rather than repeated automatic API calls.
expected: Queue entries persist, cancellation works, and no charged calls or publishing happen without explicit approval. Owner-enabled hourly YouTube scans are separate from paused legacy queue jobs, limited in rate and independently opt-out, without model usage or publishing.

name: Trend research manager and owner-approved script handoff
description: A private trend candidate can be saved, edited, removed, and used to start an original manual script.
covers: MP4 text scene balancing without orphaned final words
no AI or publishing without consent
AI quality suggestion requires separate consent
original script remains unchanged after AI quality analysis
AI review receipt per manuscript revision
free source-agnostic per-revision collaborative editorial workflow
Measured views/hour after two valid YouTube observations in same region
No false velocity for a single YouTube observation
Paid manual AI draft must conform to English 80–150-word Shorts storyboarding
steps: Sign in and open Trendlabb, find one existing YouTube source or fetch it manually.
Click Spara kandidat, refresh, and verify it remains under Sparade.
Change status to Undersöks, add a note, save and refresh; verify note and status persist.
Click Skriv eget manus and verify a new manual draft opens with its source URL and without copying video content.
Remove the candidate, refresh and verify it is gone.
Verify Publicering remains blocked.

Open an original, saved 19-word manual English script, use Skapa MP4 and download the result. Confirm the final word is not a separate 5-second scene, and that the file decodes as 1080x1920, 30 FPS, H.264 with no sound.
After the update, navigate through Översikt, Trendlabb, Videostudio and Bakgrundsjobb and verify content is retained while scheduled jobs remain paused.
Sign in, collect YouTube signals manually if necessary, open Skapa > AI-agenter and click Skapa researchplan.
Verify a stored plan contains three or fewer source-linked candidates, evidence/limits and specialist stage notes. Refresh and confirm plan persists.
Click Välj denna idé and verify the selected item stays selected after refresh. Choose Skriv originalmanus; confirm Videostudio pre-fills title and source, not copied content.
Verify manager planning and selection did not initiate AI generation, MP4 export, background jobs or publishing. AI-manus must still require separate explicit consent.

Re-fetch enough new sources to evict an older shortlisted video; the saved plan must still allow manual manuscript creation from its snapshotted source/title. Paid AI draft remains unavailable without a current trend record.
Open a saved English manuscript in Videostudio and expand Manusanalys och AI-kvalitetskontroll; verify free word/hook/paragraph/source checks display without credit consent.

With AI-provning disabled, verify paid AI-granska is disabled. With AI-provning enabled explicitly, confirm that review requires a separate unknown-cost confirmation and runs at most once per project revision.

When an AI quality report exists, reload and verify it persists; use Använd förslaget i redigeraren and verify the existing server-saved script is not replaced until Spara manus is explicitly clicked.
Verify the report is owner scoped, does not claim factual verification, never approves or publishes a video, and uses the existing shared provider-credit quota.
In Videostudio open a saved English script, expand Agentflöde · Samordnad manusgranskning and start the free four-stage workflow; the server saves role-by-role observations without calling AI.
Refresh and verify the same editorial run persists. Confirm AI-agenter shows its status and opens that same saved manuscript.
Confirm rights/fact acknowledgments require two user checkboxes, do not imply independent verification and do not auto-approve a manuscript or upload.
Attest manually, reload and verify status is Underlag redo för manuell manusgranskning. Change and save script; old run cannot be reused and a new review is required for the new revision.
Verify account B cannot see account A's editorial reports. No background AI job, credits, video export, or publishing are triggered by either endpoint.

In Trendlabb, select YouTube and view the measured views/hour sort option. If only one reading exists, no observed growth should be claimed; after two independent readings separated by at least 15 minutes, the app may show measured views/hour.
Without consenting to AI credits, verify the AI manuscript action is disabled and no generation runs.

On an explicitly owner-approved manual AI trial, verify returned script (when generation succeeds) has five English paragraphs: a 3–8 word opening hook followed by four 18–35-word scenes and totals 80–150 words.
Save the same AI manuscript and confirm that Scenplan och undertexttiming can produce its free deterministic storyboard without writing additional script text.
If provider output violates requirements, verify it is rejected rather than claimed ready; no automatic paid retry, video, or YouTube upload.
expected: Candidate saves, updates, deletions and source-link handoff are durable and private without automatic production. MP4 split is balanced with no orphaned last word. Manager plans and selections persist privately, with no automatic AI spend or uploads. The owner-scoped four-stage free editorial report persists by project revision. Manual source/rights attestation is not final script or publication approval. New consent-based AI manuscripts are validated for the free English Shorts storyboard, and malformed provider output fails closed.

name: Videogranskning local preview and empty authenticated queue
covers: Local owner review receipt never grants upload or public-release permission
Private cloud MP4 preview and human checklist review
Recovery controls for unfinished cloud media imports
Best-effort stored partial-media deletion after cancel
Narrated MP4 retains SHA-256 local and owner-scoped review flow
Recover already-committed owner-specific private video review from failed finalize acknowledgement
Reconciliation endpoint never duplicates private media or grants YouTube permission
Finalizing upload slot cannot be silently overwritten by a new import
Private upload uses body-safe segments and supports legacy media playback
description: After sign-in, review page is available without changing saved projects or performing any upload.
steps: Sign in to your existing workspace and expand Resultat.
Open Videogranskning, confirm a local JSON picker, initially disabled MP4 picker and server queue status.
In Videostudio enter an original script longer than 80 characters, add a title and create a 1080x1920 30 FPS MP4.
Download the MP4 and review-queue-item-DRAFT.json, open Videogranskning and select both files.
Verify the script hash and exact MP4 SHA-256 pass and video is playable locally; no upload or publish occurs.
Alter the MP4 bytes in a separate copy and confirm a mismatch is rejected.
Confirm no private-upload or public-publish button exists, only local file selection.
Reload and return to Översikt and Videostudio, verifying saved drafts remain unchanged.
After local preview, click Spara i min privata granskningskö on a rendered 1080x1920 MP4 within 24 MiB and confirm explicitly.
Wait for the entire chunk upload and server-side SHA verification. Sign out and back in; confirm the saved private review appears and MP4 preview is playable only by the same signed-in owner.
Verify a second logged-in account cannot read the stored MP4 or make review decisions, and forged approval flags and wrong SHA are rejected.
Check all five manual review items, watch the final video, submit the review decision; refresh and verify it is persisted with YouTube upload and publication permissions still false.
Check that cancelling or changing a completed review cannot enable publishing; confirm an altered media chunk or incomplete upload cannot finalize.
Start a cloud upload, interrupt it and use Avbryt en tidigare ofullständig import; verify a new upload can be started and cancelled import is not listed as reviewed.
After reaching 30 verified reviews, verify the next upload is rejected before transmitting MP4 chunks.
Create a licensed narration MP4 and download its matching SHA-256 packet; verify the stored reviewed file is exact and contains the chosen narration.
Confirm new private uploads transfer body-safe pieces without the previous request-body-capacity 500 failure; an old incomplete 256 KiB session must show a safe cancel-and-restart message.
For a previously completed review saved with 256 KiB pieces, open its private MP4 through authenticated segmented reads; verify the reassembled SHA-256 and owner isolation.
Interrupt the upload immediately after the server commits the private verified review but before the client receives the finish response.

In Videostudio click Kontrollera avbruten slutverifiering, and verify the existing owner-scoped receipt is reconciled and the previous video is playable from Videogranskning without a second stored review entry.
If media verification did not complete and there is no existing receipt, verify the recovery action does NOT retry import automatically, unlock media, or publish.
Try to start another upload while the old slot is finalizing. The backend must block it until reconciliation, even if its one-hour lease is expired.
Confirm the recovered media still has uploadAuthorized=false and publishAuthorized=false, and account B cannot recover account A review.
expected: The review page renders in the existing dark/light theme, server queue is safely empty or scoped to owner, no media upload takes place and existing project state persists. A genuine browser MP4 and its exact review receipt verify locally without uploading to the server; tampering is blocked. Authenticated private media storage rechecks every piece and exact full SHA before adding review metadata, with no public publishing path. An interrupted import can be cancelled without granting permissions; a full review queue rejects new media before upload. A lost network acknowledgement after successful private media verification can be repaired idempotently by explicit owner action, without duplicate media or publishing permission.

name: Review API requires login and cannot accept a browser-side fabricated import
covers: manual review and YouTube publication remain separate
description: Check that review APIs and the app respect authentication and do not expose unsafe upload shortcuts.
steps: Without sign-in, attempt to access the review API; verify the response requires authentication.
Sign in and view Videogranskning; verify queue entries are owner-scoped.
Confirm the page contains no button to import local media into the server or to publish to YouTube.
Return to existing Skapa and System navigation to confirm earlier pages remain usable.
expected: Unauthenticated access is denied, no client import or publish route is offered, and prior navigation remains functional.

name: Offline English Short storyboard and estimated subtitle export
covers: download SRT and original storyboard JSON
License-confirmed local AAC narration in MP4
Narration controls video duration without modifying pitch
Unsupported AAC encoder blocks sound export rather than silent fallback
Same timeline drives MP4 text cue overlays and exported DRAFT SRT
Hook is shown for approx 1.5-3 seconds when first paragraph is short
Length follows licensed narration or read-speed estimate
Local synthetic WAV + MP4 self-test requires no provider AI credits
Post-render MP4 proof validates unique vide and soun track handlers
MP4 movie duration from mvhd and true display dimensions from video tkhd
Browser metadata check runs after a decoded video frame, tolerating only 1088 H.264 macroblock padding
Diagnose exact browser and MP4 dimensions/duration on a mismatch rather than generic failure
SHA-256 and no-publication review receipt created without server upload
Changing manuscript source URL invalidates stale video preview
All ordinary Shorts exports check actual MP4 video and audio tracks, not just browser metadata
Stable monotonically increasing AAC packet timestamps during voiceover muxing
No intermediate AAC flush; exactly one final flush avoids Chrome macOS repeated encoder padding
Reject AAC packet totals or durations more than 0.2 s over the selected narration rather than disguising them as valid
Reject MP4 movie duration more than 0.25 s away from the intended duration
One-click browser-local Kokoro neural English narration plus 9:16 MP4 from a saved manuscript
No neural model/API call before a human presses create
Exact script revision and owner identity gate neural result and final MP4
Changing a manuscript invalidates old neural voice to prevent reading old text
Manual video review remains required and no YouTube publication is added
description: A saved eligible manuscript can show a draft scene plan and export SRT/JSON without online AI calls.
steps: Sign in and go to Skapa > Videostudio.
Open an English saved manuscript with 80–150 words and at least three paragraphs beginning with a short hook; ensure the current version is saved.
Expand Scenplan och undertexttiming and check scene count, elapsed time, 1080x1920 format and estimated timestamps.
Download the draft SRT and JSON files, checking they are clearly marked as estimated and unapproved.
Edit the manuscript without saving and confirm the old plan is no longer presented as valid; save to recompute.
Attach a rights-cleared English 20-second PCM WAV voiceover; without rights confirmation the MP4 generation must be blocked.
After confirming rights, create MP4; confirm AAC narration is audible and the video length matches source narration, while text captions are explicitly approximate.
Remove sound file and render silent MP4; ensure the user is not charged for TTS or online AI voice.
Try on a browser with no AAC WebCodecs support; a clear error must appear.

Save an original English 90–115-word manuscript with a short 3–8-word first paragraph. Pick Cinematic. Create MP4 and check that hook appears for 1.5–3 seconds and longer scenes have proportional screen time.
Export MP4 timeline DRAFT SRT and confirm each cue timestamp matches the actual changing on-video text, sequential without gaps or overlaps, from 0 through video length.
Switch to Bold, render again and verify visibly different animated graphics without any third-party footage.
Add a rights-checked narration file and verify that video and exported DRAFT SRT end with the narration-driven video length; timings must remain labeled estimated, not phoneme or word aligned.
Confirm a silent original MP4 still works when no audio was selected, and private review remains fully manually gated.
Go to Videostudio. Click Skapa och verifiera lokal testvideo with no existing script or rights-cleared uploaded audio. Keep browser tab open.
After completion confirm preview plays a 21-second H.264 1080x1920 demonstration with audible pulsing synthetic tone, not spoken narration.
Confirm validation waits for decoded video data on Chrome for macOS rather than rejecting transient metadata; verify the MP4 container independently reports tkhd 1080x1920 and mvhd about 21 seconds.
Simulate MP4 with wrong track display dimensions or duration and ensure the export fails with precise browser/container values rather than silently approving corrupted media.
Confirm the self-test reports exactly one MP4 video and one audio track, local SHA-256, matching estimated draft SRT, and unsigned owner-review packet that forbids publishing.
Download demo MP4 and SRT. Confirm this has not saved a project, started AI credits, placed any video in private cloud queue or uploaded to YouTube.
Switch to an ordinary manuscript, export and verify normal rights checks. Change the source URL and verify old rendered preview and download are invalidated and a new export is needed.
Export a normal Short with no narration and verify confirmation reports 1 video and 0 audio tracks based on the MP4 container.
Export with a licensed, selected voiceover and verify confirmation reports 1 video and exactly 1 audio track; any missing AAC track must reject the export rather than claim narration is present.
Generate the same rights-checked voiceover video twice and verify both fully play with audible sound, with no non-monotonic DTS timestamp error during MP4 muxing.

Save a valid 90–110 word English manuscript. Click Skapa AI-röst + färdig MP4 and verify Kokoro downloads only on demand, speech reads the saved manuscript, MP4 has video and spoken AAC audio, and preview remains private.
Modify the script, reload or switch accounts before generation completes; stale voice and MP4 must not be committed for the wrong manuscript.
Fail Kokoro model loading or exceed 45 seconds of speech; the UI must show a real failure instead of publishing, silently omitting voice or claiming a completed Short.

On Chrome macOS run the built-in 21-second synthetic AAC self-test and confirm MP4 movie duration is approximately 21 seconds rather than 22.42 seconds. Verify one video and one audio track, playable sound and SHA-256.
Try 45-second speech audio and verify the encoder never performs intermediate AAC flushes, does not accumulate extra silence, and fails closed for more than 0.2 seconds of audio overrun.
expected: Saved manuscript yields a draft storyboarding preview and downloaded planning files. Unsaved or invalid text is rejected. No AI calls, YouTube uploads, or approvals are triggered. A locally selected licensed narration is included as AAC when supported, but no built-in AI TTS or automatic speech alignment is claimed. MP4 and its separately downloadable estimated SRT share an exact frame timeline and the user can choose between two original motion-graphic templates. A user-triggered browser-only E2E media smoke test supplies a synthetic audible tone and proves both tracks and hash evidence, while remaining clearly separate from real voiceover or any cloud media upload. Every exported media asset, not only the isolated self-test, is checked for actual MP4 tracks before success UI.
